FREE TRAIN RIDES!  📣 

The Department of Transportation (DOTr) announced that free train rides on MRT-3, LRT-1, and LRT-2 will be implemented starting at 12PM today, July 21, 2025, following the directive of President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr. amid persistent heavy rains and flooding in Metro Manila.

"Prayoridad ng Department of Transportation ang kaligtasan ng mga pasahero at tiyaking mabilis at ligtas silang makakauwi sa kanilang bahay, sa kabila ng malakas na pag-ulan at pagbaha sa ilang mga lugar sa Metro Manila," the DOTr said in their Facebook post. (Facebook/Department of Transportation - Philippines)

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 32 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 2:00 PM, 21 July 2025(Monday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila, Cavite, Batangas, Laguna, Zambales, Bataan, Pampanga, Rizal and Bulacan.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Tarlac.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Quezon and Nueva Ecija which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 PM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
